about: A causal conclusion needs its causal link among its premises: two facts that happened do not make one the cause of the other.

findings.title: Crisis timeline
findings.content: Subprime mortgage defaults rose sharply in 2007. Lehman Brothers failed in September 2008. The inquiry found that Lehman's heavy exposure to subprime-backed securities caused its losses.

claims.claim: Subprime mortgage defaults rose sharply in 2007.
The inquiry found that Lehman's heavy exposure to subprime-backed securities caused its losses.

conclusions.statement: Rising subprime defaults caused Lehman Brothers' failure.
The inquiry attributes Lehman Brothers' losses to its exposure to subprime-backed securities, as subprime defaults rose in 2007.
